newsitem.title: USA: High temperatures, no rain in Florida citrus belt.
newsitem.headline: High temperatures, no rain in Florida citrus belt.

text.p: Temperatures above the 80 degree mark and no measurable rain hit the Florida citrus belt last week, the Florida Agricultural Statistics Service (FASS), said.
Growers in all areas are using irrigation to maintain good tree and fruit condition.
In the week ended January 5, caretakers were mowing, discing and chopping cover crops prior to harvest and for fire protection, FASS said.
According to FASS, Harvest is increasing following the holiday slow down.
FASS reported an estimated 594,000 boxes of navel oranges were harvested in the week ended January 5, up from 141,000 boxes the previous week and 543,000 boxes in the week ended December 22.
An estimated 8,872,000 boxes of early and mid oranges were harvested in the week ended January 5, up from 5,840,000 boxes the prior week and 9,661,000 boxes the week ended December 22, FASS said.
